qr = QuantumRegister(4, 'q')
qc = QuantumCircuit(qr)

# Qubits: q0, q1 are inputs; q2 is workspace; q3 is ancilla for phase
# Condition: (q0 AND q1) computed onto q2, then phase applied via q3

# Compute q0 AND q1 into workspace q2
qc.ccx(qr[0], qr[1], qr[2])

# Compute a second condition: NOT(q0) AND q2 onto ancilla q3
qc.x(qr[0])
qc.ccx(qr[0], qr[2], qr[3])
qc.x(qr[0])

# Apply Z phase on ancilla q3
qc.z(qr[3])

# Uncompute
qc.x(qr[0])
qc.ccx(qr[0], qr[2], qr[3])
qc.x(qr[0])
qc.ccx(qr[0], qr[1], qr[2])

# Put query register into superposition

qc.barrier()

# Oracle for secret string
for i, bit in enumerate(reversed(secret)):
    if bit == '1':
        qc.cx(qr[i], qr[3])

qc.barrier()

# Undo Hadamards on query register
for i in range(3):

qc.measure(qr[0:3], cr[0:3])

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister
from qiskit.circuit.library import QFT

qr = QuantumRegister(3, 'q')
cr = ClassicalRegister(3, 'c')
qc = QuantumCircuit(qr, cr)

# Prepare |101>
qc.x(qr[0])
qc.x(qr[2])

# Apply 3-qubit QFT
qft = QFT(num_qubits=3)
qc.append(qft.to_instruction(), qr[:])

qc.barrier()

# Apply inverse QFT
iqft = QFT(num_qubits=3).inverse()
qc.append(iqft.to_instruction(), qr[:])

qc.measure(qr, cr)
